sentences.text:
on 9 June, 2025
 Honourable Sri Justice E.V.Venugopal
 Writ Petition No.20020 of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed seeking:
"a Writ, Order or Direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents herein more particularly respondent Nos.1 and 2 in not depositing the enhanced compensation amounts/decretal amounts in terms of Award and decree dated 12.01.2024 in LAOP No.9 of 2018 on the file of Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority for the State of Telangana, at Hyderabad to the credit of E.P.No.9 of 2024

is illegal, arbitrary,
violation of Article 21 and 300-A of Constitution of India, violation of Act 30 of 2013 and also contrary to the settled Principles of law and consequently direct the Respondents herein to forthwith deposit the enhanced compensation amounts/decretal amounts in terms of Award and decree dated 12.01.2024 in LAOP No.9 of 2018 on the file of Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad to the credit of E.P.No.9 of 2024".

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. During the course of hearing, Mr. Laxmi Narayana, learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for respondent Nos.4 and 5, has produced the written instructions submitted by the Office of the Special Deputy Collector, L.A.Unit-7, Rajanna-Sircilla, dated 17.04.2025 and would submit

entities.text: Office of the Special Deputy Collector, L.A.Unit-7, Rajanna-Sircilla
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: that nothing is pending as on date to be credited and entire amounts in terms of award and decree dated 12.01.2024 in L.A.O.P.No.9 of 2018 on the file of the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority for the State of Telangana (for short "LA authority") has already been deposited to the credit of E.P.No.9 of 2024 on the file of Land Acquisition Authority in compliance to the order passed by the Tribunal

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: and hence the cause in the present writ petition does not survive.
Therefore, he seeks dismissal of this writ petition.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner did not take any objection to dismiss this case but, requested this Court to grant liberty to pursue their remedies as available under law.

4. Recording the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for respondent Nos.4 and 5, this writ petition is dismissed as infructuous granting liberty to the petitioner to pursue his remedies as available under law.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition, shall also stand closed.
